question: how many cathodes are compared in the review articles

trace.query: SELECT doc, id, page, text FROM sentences WHERE (text ILIKE '%compar%' OR text ILIKE '%cathodes were%' OR text ILIKE '%cathode materials%') AND doc IN ('aenm-2022','ensm-2021','ensm-2020','mattod-2020','adma-2020') AND text ILIKE '%cathode%' LIMIT 80

SELECT doc, id, page, text FROM sentences WHERE doc='aenm-2022' AND text ILIKE '%cathode%' AND (text ILIKE '%compar%' OR text ILIKE '%five%' OR text ILIKE '%four%' OR text ILIKE '%three%' OR text ILIKE '%several%' OR text ILIKE '%various%' OR text ILIKE '%different%') LIMIT 60
SELECT doc, id, text FROM sentences WHERE doc IN ('aenm-2022','ensm-2021','mattod-2020','ensm-2020','cssc-2020','susmat-2020') AND (text ILIKE '%review%') AND (text ILIKE '%cathode%') LIMIT 40
SELECT id, figure_id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE figure_id IN ('aenm-2022:p8.F7','aenm-2022:p3.F2') OR figure_id LIKE 'aenm-2022%' LIMIT 40

runs.text: The review articles do not state a single count of cathodes. The clearest comparison is in the aenm-2022 review on next-generation cobalt-free cathodes, which names the cathode classes it compares:

runs.quote: layered, spinel, olivine, and disordered rock-salt (DRX) cathodes

runs.text: . The same classes are listed in its introduction:

runs.quote: layered, spinel, olivine, and disordered rock-salt systems

runs.text: . The list of classes, not a count of individual materials, is the comparison the review makes. The surface-coating review (ensm-2021) instead compares coated and uncoated cathode materials in its tables, and its tables do not give a single headline number.

rendered: The review articles do not state a single count of cathodes. The clearest comparison is in the aenm-2022 review on next-generation cobalt-free cathodes, which names the cathode classes it compares: layered, spinel, olivine, and disordered rock-salt (DRX) cathodes[1]. The same classes are listed in its introduction: layered, spinel, olivine, and disordered rock-salt systems[2]. The list of classes, not a count of individual materials, is the comparison the review makes. The surface-coating review (ensm-2021) instead compares coated and uncoated cathode materials in its tables, and its tables do not give a single headline number.
